library_metadata.scope: Complete interpretation guide for all planetary aspect combinations
library_metadata.interpretation_structure: Each aspect includes: basic meaning, psychological dynamics, potential expressions, growth opportunities, relationship dynamics

special_considerations.separating: Aspect is waning, integrating the lesson
special_considerations.out_of_sign: Same degree different signs, subtle influence

conjunction.basic_meaning: Unity of will and emotion, conscious and unconscious merged
conjunction.psychological: Inner harmony, what you want aligns with what you need, integrated personality
conjunction.growth_opportunity: Develop awareness of how others see you differently than you see yourself
conjunction.relationship_dynamic: Comfortable with self, attracts partners who appreciate authenticity

sextile.basic_meaning: Harmony between will and emotions with effort
sextile.psychological: Can harmonize identity and feelings through conscious choice
sextile.growth_opportunity: Actively develop emotional awareness to support goals
sextile.relationship_dynamic: Can meet partner's emotional and ego needs with awareness

square.basic_meaning: Tension between will and emotions, ego and needs in conflict
square.psychological: What you want vs. what you need creates internal friction
square.growth_opportunity: Integrate emotional needs with life purpose, find middle path
square.relationship_dynamic: May project inner conflict onto partner, needs emotional security to shine
square.famous_examples: Many successful people have this aspect—it creates drive

trine.basic_meaning: Natural flow between will and emotions, easy integration
trine.psychological: Comfortable in own skin, self-acceptance, inner peace
challenges: Might not develop emotional depth without challenge
trine.growth_opportunity: Use natural ease to help others integrate their conflicts

opposition.basic_meaning: Polarity between will and emotions, conscious vs. unconscious in dialogue
opposition.psychological: See-saw between ego needs and emotional needs, seeks balance through relationships
positive_expressions: Awareness of both sides of self
Can mediate between head and heart
Attracts relationships that mirror inner polarity
challenges: Feels torn between shoulds and wants
May project one side onto others
opposition.growth_opportunity: Own both sides—be both strong and vulnerable
opposition.relationship_dynamic: Attracts partners who embody disowned emotional side, must integrate rather than project

quincunx.basic_meaning: Awkward relationship between will and emotions, constant adjustment needed
quincunx.psychological: What you want and what you feel don't speak the same language
quincunx.growth_opportunity: Learn to translate between emotional and ego needs, develop flexibility

conjunction.basic_meaning: Mind and identity fused, communication is self-expression
conjunction.psychological: Think and speak from core self, identity strongly linked to ideas
challenges: Can be too subjective (Sun burns Mercury)
Can be overly mental in self-concept
conjunction.growth_opportunity: Separate self-worth from intelligence, listen more
conjunction.career: Excellent for writing, speaking, teaching, communications
conjunction.note: Mercury never more than 28° from Sun, so only conjunction possible

conjunction.basic_meaning: Identity and values merged, love and self-expression unified
conjunction.psychological: What you love IS who you are, natural charm and grace
challenges: Can prioritize being liked over being authentic
Might avoid conflict to maintain harmony
conjunction.growth_opportunity: Stand in authentic self even when not universally liked
conjunction.relationship_dynamic: Attracts love easily, needs to be loved for true self
conjunction.career: Arts, entertainment, beauty, diplomacy, public relations
conjunction.note: Venus never more than 48° from Sun, so only conjunction, semisextile, semisquare possible

semisextile.basic_meaning: Slight friction between identity and values, minor adjustments needed
semisextile.growth_opportunity: Integrate love and self-expression through small consistent efforts

semisquare.basic_meaning: Minor tension between ego and values, subtle irritation
challenges: Minor conflicts between what you want and what you value
Can be hard on self about appearance or charm
semisquare.growth_opportunity: Accept that love and self-worth aren't always aligned perfectly

conjunction.basic_meaning: Will and action united, dynamic self-expression, warrior energy
conjunction.psychological: Impulse and identity merged, natural assertiveness
challenges: Anger tied to ego (takes things personally)
conjunction.growth_opportunity: Channel warrior energy constructively, develop patience
conjunction.relationship_dynamic: Needs partner who can handle intensity, may compete with partner
conjunction.career: Military, athletics, surgery, entrepreneurship, competitive fields
conjunction.health: High vitality but risk of accidents, inflammation, burnout

sextile.basic_meaning: Harmonious flow between will and action with effort
positive_expressions: Good balance of confidence and action

square.basic_meaning: Friction between ego and drive, impatience with self
square.psychological: Feel blocked or frustrated in expressing will
challenges: May be too aggressive in self-assertion
square.growth_opportunity: Learn constructive anger expression, develop patience
square.relationship_dynamic: May have power struggles, needs to express anger healthily

trine.basic_meaning: Natural flow between will and action, effortless courage
challenges: Could lack drive if too easy
trine.growth_opportunity: Use natural courage to help others develop theirs

opposition.basic_meaning: Polarized will and drive, ego battles desire for action

opposition.growth_opportunity: Own your aggression, don't project onto others
opposition.relationship_dynamic: Attracts competitive or aggressive partners, must own warrior energy
opposition.career: Thrives in competitive environments once integrated

quincunx.basic_meaning: Awkward relationship between ego and drive
challenges: Unsure how to assert self effectively
quincunx.growth_opportunity: Adjust and adapt expressions of will and action

conjunction.basic_meaning: Expanded identity, optimistic self-expression, larger-than-life presence

conjunction.relationship_dynamic: Generous in love, needs freedom and growth in relationships

opposition.basic_meaning: Polarized identity and belief, ego vs. philosophy

uranus_neptune.themes: Revolution meets spirituality, innovation in consciousness

synthesis_principles: Never interpret aspects in isolation—always consider sign, house, dignity
Outer planet aspects are generational unless involving angles or luminaries
Applying aspects are more dynamic than separating
Aspects from angular houses are stronger
Multiple aspects to same planet create complex dynamics
Aspect patterns (T-square, Grand Trine, etc.) override individual aspects
interpretation_guidelines.positive_use_vs_shadow: Every aspect has constructive and destructive expressions—choice matters
interpretation_guidelines.timing_considerations: Aspects activate at different life stages based on progressions and transits
interpretation_guidelines.free_will: Aspects show potential dynamics, not fated outcomes
